notes.title: Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood - LIVE ACTION TRAILER
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=_eBFerc4sDI;full][/previewyoutube]

Howdy folks!

Devespresso Games is pleased to announce that Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood will be dropping on Steam tomorrow (April 8th)! This game has been one year in the making and directly follows on the heels of our last title, The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters. Our players will be happy to know that this title is jam-packed with our distinct visuals and story-driven gameplay. So, make sure to join us in welcoming Scarlet, the newest member of our gaming universe, to the family!

We filmed a special live-action trailer to celebrate the occasion and it JUST went live. Check it out above!

[h2]Synopsis
[/h2]
Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood is the story of a young woman who finds herself tossed into the magical realm of Glome by a rogue tornado. It is there she must take up the mantle of the “Red Witch” and learn to wield her powerful Womping Stick to help a troupe of lost Munchkin safely navigate their way through the perilous domain of the Black Witch, LeFaba. The evil sorceress has no qualms about destroying any unwary intruders that trespass in The Wicked Wood. While Scarlet may be completely outmatched, she soon learns a recursion hex has her reliving the same day. Can she use her newfound powers and the knowledge gained from her previous lives to outwit LeFaba and lead the troupe to safety?

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29663532/2dd8faa0995468add645e516c988e6c32ae000a1.jpg[/img]
Many of you may be wondering what to expect this time around. If you’re a fan of puzzle-solving/adventure games you’ll feel right at home in “The Wicked Wood.” This game has more puzzles than you can shake a stick at. There are also multiple paths to success featuring 10 unique endings to be unlocked. But just because this game more heavily focuses on puzzles doesn’t mean that it skimps on action; you’ll have to avoid the bumbling Dodobo, mischievous Monkeyta, and a relentless wolf to survive this forest.  

[h2]Discord[/h2]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/devespresso][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29663532/2b6d16d2fbe5d54ff1e8ff624d478f4372de9b7a.jpg[/img][/url]
Make sure to join our friendly Discord server for exclusive updates, to connect with like-minded gamers, and chat with the devs. We'll be sure to nudge you in the right direction if you've been stuck on a puzzle "too" long as well. ;)   

We're looking forward to meeting all of you!

notes.title: Patch 1.10 is live!
notes.notes:
To the amazing community,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33788427/cc3d871c94fceebea9e5a6df7dd1948c19c757a8.png[/img]

Thanks for your patient and passion, Version 1.10 is now live!

Like 1.08 [Combat Redeem] patch, this patch represents our careful thought through remained community feedback and implement many changes that will definitely enhance the overall player experience. We have been listening to the awesome perspectives our players who have been played the game in several times, even with the mixed score, and it holds the team that this game has still many attractive aspects to be loved. After The Coma 2 Release, some of devs were able to revisit the game to finally update this patch, and there are issues that are best solved in our hands.

For details about the biggest changes, please check below.


[h3]1. Combat: Damage Impact Enhancement [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33788427/06c8e8eedbef8786eb802dd886e06ad8956f9cb8.jpg[/img]
In previous game, the dmg int numbers are shown onto the character portraits above the actual combat situation, without any impact particle, so it was less impactful. In Patch 1.10, there doesn't only have additional particle per each dmg value, but also the dmg int numbers are appeared at the targeted monster, so it would be much more understandable and feel impact from your combat decision. When it comes to the monster's attack, still the int will show onto your character portrait UI on the top left, for your easy circulation.

[h3]2. Bottom Command GUI is finally flipped[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33788427/cbdea93573a2096c5145cca9385e7d44093bb290.jpg[/img]
As you already figured out at the previous game screenshot, the GUI if finally flipped! So many gamers complained the positions of the Left/right wing buttons (It's my bad, since I only focused on Keyboard key locations... - Minho), and it has been issued many times. Finally, we figured out how to do -  which has to be checked in every sector of the in-game GUIs - and you can play with it with Patch 1.10.

[h3]3. Minimap Redeemed[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33788427/09afb8b9a1f310ba1df8e97ba40f51aa8a5b45b5.jpg[/img]

This has been also major issued. 'I cannot figure the camera angle of the game!' Minho thought it would be okay with 'tilting your head a bit', but eventually it was his complacency.
We fixed 'all' minimaps (ranging from Citymaps to final boss stages) onto the right angle for side-scroll view. 

[i]"The map like this is perfect! Thx to make the map like this its more easy to understand now :3 It's really simple, I can understand it its clear!"[/i] - Alma (1.10 tester)

As Alma said, it dramatically reduces your stress while exploring the fields. We hope the changes becomes your better gameplay experiences!


[h2]There are other minor changes as well!
[/h2]
[list]
[*] One of note pages has been missing, We are sincerely sorry for the gamers who has been seeking it... [b]we fixed it.[/b]
[*] [b]Dialogue Box is newly decorated.[/b]
[*] [b]Fast-forward LUI[/b] is shown onto the combat situation! It is 'also' usable at the Trap event.
[*] Trap event animation speed is raised. [b]3s -> 2s[/b].
[*] So many mimics! Even the team was frustrated, so [b]we reduced their appearing rate[/b].
[*] Some map paths where have been confusing players are changed. [b]Some places becomes completely replaced.[/b]
[*] [b]City map & field maps[/b] (Top viewed) now show the location icons even without approaching them. Enjoy to explore the locations.
[*] Some [b]map glitches are fixed or replaced [/b]whenever we (and testers) found.
[/list]

Again, big thanks to our amazing community of players who have played the game. You guys have been speechlessly amazing and your support means the world to us, even this 2020. We hope the new changes motivate you to try out the game again, and enjoy.

When it comes to the feedbacks, the team is also super active on Discord, so it's also a good opportunity to speak directly to us, ask questions, or just talk about the game with other like-minded players.

[h1][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/f3Rgusq]Join us here![/url][/h1]

| Minho, over and out.

Devespresso Games is proud to announce that THE COMA 2: VICIOUS SISTERS, the long-awaited sequel to its Korean-horror cult classic will make its playable debut as part of the Indie MegaBooth lineup at PAX West 2019. The game will be available as part of the MiniBooth showcase on Friday, August 30th and Saturday, August 31st. The game’s booth will be located on the 4th floor in the Main Expo Hall.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GZdRoU8BikE]Check out the trailer here.[/url]
 
[h1]SYNOPSIS[/h1]
Mina Park, a student of Sehwa High, awakens at night in her school. It isn’t long before she realizes that something is amiss. The once-familiar surroundings looks twisted by something dark and sinister. She finds herself pursued by someone or something that looks eerily like her teacher. To survive, Mina must venture beyond the boundaries of Sehwa High and into the surrounding district. There, she will encounter strange creatures, mysterious strangers, and uneasy allies.

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters is an atmospheric, story-driven game. Immerse yourself in the warped Sehwa district as you encounter an engaging cast of characters, solve puzzles, discover revealing clues, and fight for survival against a relentless psycho.

Heroines, forced to confront their worst fears, rarely emerge unscathed. Over the course of the story, Mina will encounter dangerous scenarios from which she could sustain permanent damage. Craft items to anticipate future dangers to avoid injury.

Dark Song is now more fearsome and powerful than ever before. Falling into her grasp could spell instant death. Running and wielding your flashlight makes you an easy target. You must precariously balance the urgency of exploration with your absolute need to survive!  
 
[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
 
[b]A Relentless killer[/b]
Fear Dark Song’s relentless pursuit to kill you, now with an all-new AI.
 
[b]Survival Crafting[/b]
Craft items to prepare for critical life-or-death situations or risk permanent injury.
 
[b]Explore[/b]
Explore the nightmarish district that surrounds Sehwa High and discover its dark secrets.
 
[b]Scavenge[/b]
Search for resources and tools to survive deadly encounters and afflictions and to progress into unexplored areas.
 
[b]Hide[/b]
Hide to avoid detection and certain death. Pass challenges to conceal your location. 
 
[b]Hand-Illustrated Graphics[/b]
Featuring vibrant, hand-illustrated graphics and Korean manhwa-style visuals.

notes.title: Version 1.08 is Live
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/0b971112842f7eb30e174d3ce1d884f32266e7b8.jpg[/img]

Announcement: Please note that with this update your Perk Points will be reset and must be distributed again. Not a real biggie, just consider it a second chance to redo your Lyric.

///

To everyone who has waited patiently for the past two weeks, Version 1.08 is now live!

This patch represents our effort to parse through objective community feedback and implement changes that will definitely enhance the overall player experience. Since launch, we have prioritized listening to the amazing perspectives our players have brought forward. After all, there are some issues that are best solved from exactly that type of input.

For details about the biggest changes, please check below. 

[h1]Adjustable Difficulty[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/d9158843f9b9c16494b03a11f17cbac40bc6ed1c.png[/img]
When we started making Vambrace the objective was to create an extremely punishing but fair game. We wanted to balance it in such a way that players had a genuine sigh of relief when they managed to make it through a neighborhood. We received feedback that early versions subjected players to the whims of RNG a little too much. After that, we rebalanced encounters and enemy stats for a friendlier learning curve.

The good news is that now you can have your cake and eat it too. This version has 2 difficulty levels: Standard & Cold Soul. Standard difficulty represents the patched difficulty that was much easier from what players experienced before and at launch. Cold Soul is the definitive experience with more combat encounters, tougher enemies, and a faster Geistometer.

[h1]New Skills[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/5518b1ce8f2232f62e264dcfa66eeaa05769c00b.png[/img]
ALL characters now come with 3 skills. 2 default skills & 1 randomized skill. This means that the 3rd skill will vary from hire to hire. Maybe you hired a new recruit with a particularly awesome combination of skills. Now you’ll have to think twice about letting him/her go. It also significantly varies the tactics you can use in combat. You can still craft relics to alter your Ultimate Flourish for even more variety in combat.

[h1]New Flourish System[/h1]
With the addition of multiple flourishes, we’ve also implemented a new point based system for these skills. Characters will have a default of 5 Flourish points to spend. Each Flourish skill has a different Flourish Point cost, so be sure to check that out before you use them. This also adds a new layer of tactics to combat as you weigh what skills to use and how to build points for future attacks.

[h1]New Monster Type System[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/70697a871c57d88817c16502308c43f20e84e9ba.png[/img]
Creatures will now come in 7 varieties. Certain skills will have bonuses against these creature types. Their type will be indicated in the icon below their portrait. The basic types are as follows:

Flesh: Weak against some melee skills.

Wraith: Weak against some Magick skills.

Blood: Weak against some Hedge skills.

Hedge: Weak against some Blood skills.

Tek: Weak against Grenades and bullets.

Archonic: Weak against Lyric.

Shade: No weaknesses.

[h1]New Items[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/a7e33fe7fb44ecc453a786e983f14362e426dcb5.png[/img]
To accommodate the new skills, we’ve altered existing Relics and have also added some new ones to the mix. Every character class will have a special relic that enhances their specific skill. This Ultimate Flourish can be upgraded two levels.

[h1]Bugs & Text[/h1]
We’ve also worked diligently to smash a variety of bugs and correct any text issues we managed to catch as well. Perhaps our favorite “minor” bug to fix was the inventory cursor issue.
 
[h1]Outro[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/7445232498eeed94bc6d9bdf478833986ddb5f82.png[/img]
Once again, a huge shout out and thanks to our amazing community of players. You guys have been totally amazing and your support means the world to us. We’re just really happy we can share this world with you. As always, we look forward to your continued input as we strive to make Vambrace the best version of itself. We hope the new systems motivate you to try out Cold Soul mode and experience the difficulty it was meant to be played at.

-Tris, over and out!

notes.title: Cards, Badges, & More!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/289c44de248ded86e215cee06de8fdce1c445757.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

It’s been some time since we last spoke. We’re coming hot off of E3 and nearing the conclusion of our tests for the next big update. So, I’m dropping by with some news and a few teasers for what’s headed your way next week.  

[h1]Steam Cards, Badges, & Profile Backgrounds
[/h1]
Some of you may have already noticed that Vambrace trading cards have just gone live. There are 15 basic cards to collect and a pretty sweet foil Aetherbrace badge waiting to be attained. We hope this enhances your Steam experience. In addition to that…

[h1]Big Update Incoming![/h1]
There’s a great deal we’ve been chomping at the bit to share for 1.08. We wanted to make sure we spent enough time testing things before we made any official announcements. I’m excited to say we’re happy with the current state of these new developments.

Since the game’s launch, we’ve made a huge effort to assess feedback from the community. We prioritize objective ideas that we believe stays true to the spirit of the game’s original design intents AND enhances player experience. Something we’ve noted from both positive and negative reviews is that many players would have liked more “depth” to the combat system. 

Perhaps, what the community will find more surprising is that our early designs had features that were intentionally left on the cutting room floor to maintain a minimalist combat system. We are revisiting some of those features and adding a lot of new content to balance things out. 

[h1]Features[/h1]
-An enhanced point based flourish system 
-3 default skills per character with enhanced skills from Relics
-New recruits have a randomized skill 
-10 new relics that can be crafted or haggled from merchants.
-Monster Types which yield bonuses or penalties in combat
-Adjustable difficulty levels in the options
-A new monster, varied formations, and teams
-Rebalanced stats for enemy encounters
-Finally, a fix for the dreaded teleporting inventory cursor!

The result is a more robust combat system that requires a deeper level of tactics. However, it doesn’t compromise our original design intents and feels like a natural extension of the game. More details about each to come with the next patch.

Until then, feast your eyes on these preview images:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/ba4a1f101f6cb5f588b8e98448e95dd0e79a5188.jpg[/img]

[h1]Outro[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/7445232498eeed94bc6d9bdf478833986ddb5f82.png[/img]

As always, a huge shout out to the community. Thanks for your continued support. Please continue to share your questions and comments in the discussion boards. We love hearing from you guys!

Tris, over and out!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/71dc00a7518642061f2790d58cf2b765eb0e1fff.png[/img]

Version 1.06 is here and with it comes some much-anticipated features and a few fixes.

[h1]New Game +[/h1]
The biggest feature this build has to offer is our addition of a New Game +. Access to it will be revealed to those who complete the game. This feature will allow players to complete the game faster in order to unlock missed costumes and new endings. 

Only read the line below if you’ve already completed the game.

[spoiler]Pay special attention to the end game epilogue scene for a clue about how to reach New Game +[/spoiler]

[h1]Hedge Mage[/h1]
After listening to community feedback, we revisited the Hedge Mage and tweaked some of her stats. We believe the new build yields a companion that will be a true asset to your team in the icy wastes. Some of her changes include:

-[b]Recovery[/b] now heals Target ally for Health +2.
-Her Flourish points charge faster.
-[b]Healing Light[/b] now heals target ally for Health +3, That Ally gains +1 Health per turn for 3 turns.
-[b]Life Fusion[/b], a relic skill gained from the Amulet of the Matriarch, now heals target ally +4 Health and receives [b]Super Rejuvenation[/b] status for +2 Health per turn for 4 turns.

[h1]Bullion Chips[/h1]
Combat drops now include Bullion Chips in varieties of copper, silver, and gold. These hold no practical use, but they can be traded with merchant for hellion.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/ebf5b0a8239005d0271a77d9da351b383af8f95b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/6b38ecbea0d2ee58dc4849e709ec1c81711eb2c3.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/489b2a46de8ec2aa602133255c69254bee13ad62.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/7df5e086337197130032305108479d15364fd874.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/1205d2a0a25c8101727ecd7b8225935b4679ff0b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/2c5a563bc21653e60894e923b96a00c8b6fd968f.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Haven Closet & Bed[/h1]
[spoiler]For those who completed Chapter 5, a closet and bed are now immediately available in Haven so you can rest. You may also rest at the Lost Lady Inn in the ruins of Dalearch.[/spoiler]

[h1]Skip Tutorial[/h1]
If you are a player who has already cleared the tutorial, this option will appear. Technically, not a new feature but we're letting you know it exists.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/69c3ad2539c91bd63573969f296bd1db2d5aa1ad.png[/img]

[h1]Fast Forward[/h1]
A tutorial graphic has been added to show players they can speed up combat with the Shift button. 

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
-A bug with the Arcaster’s eye has been fixed.
-Various lines of broken dialogue, typos, etc. have been fixed. 
-All-Mother’s Rosary has been removed from the tutorial.

[h1]Steam Cards[/h1]
A full collection of Steam cards are in the process of being approved. 

[h1]Outro[/h1]
As always, we’re still discovering stray issues with dialogue, and the odd broken line of text here or there. We appreciate the help of everyone who’s been sharing this feedback on the discussion boards. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/7445232498eeed94bc6d9bdf478833986ddb5f82.png[/img]

Please continue to do so and we will implement those changes as they are brought to our attention. Your contributions are the lifeblood of our future updates!

Tris, over and out!

notes.title: Say What?!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/c67dca3bd4c6c56f784e150d238f8367e7b73d30.png[/img]

[h1]One Serving of Replayability, Coming Up!
[/h1]

Ask, and you shall receive! Well, not [i]always[/i]. We are just human after all. Some of us, anyway. The verdict is still out on [b]Minho[/b] who may be more machine than man (at the rate he's working). But I digress...

What could make this game better, you ask? More replayability, you say? You're absolutely right! As such, we're adding our very unique take on a [b]New Game +[/b] mode in the upcoming 1.06 Patch. We're sure you're all gonna get a kick out of this. More details to come.

Also, Steam Cards. Yes, they're coming very soon. Please hang tight!

But that's not all. We'll also be adding a special new loot drop that will be sure to spice up those combat encounters. 

[b]Stay tuned for 1.06![/b]

[h1]Thanks![/h1]

If I may be allowed to indulge in an excuse for any lingering issues... 

Between the 4 of us (at Devespresso) there is a lot of ground to cover for a game of Vambrace's scope. Also only 24 hours in a day. (Darn it!) 

The important point is that we're LISTENING. I can't emphasize how important the community's feedback is. It has been absolutely essential in helping us bring Vambrace closer to the best version of itself that it could possibly be. Step by step, we'll get there.

Your insight is super valuable. We appreciate the efforts of those who continue to notify us of any oversights we've made (bugs, broken text, etc.). We'll do our best to patch those up ASAP. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/7445232498eeed94bc6d9bdf478833986ddb5f82.png[/img]

Please review the game and let us know what we got right, what went wrong, and how we can improve the experience.

-Tris, over and out!

Version 1.05 is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/3b5f5e5451c3716f232c9151f2876ab23359a44f.png[/img]

Hey all, this is our biggest update yet. We’ve added some big changes, so please check below to learn more. We believe, with this update, a real improvement has been made to eliminate whatever "unfair" elements existed in the game and to truly balance the number of combat encounters per neighborhood.

[h1]Shelter[/h1]
Vambrace has always been a game about survival. In this new update, you’ll find Shelters on the overworld paths between Neighborhoods. Shelters provide a safe place for your team to use items and craft with the loot you’ve picked up. Since your team will be exposed on these open roads, however, you’ll need to camp inside neighborhoods to replenish Health and Vigor. This means players will no longer be subject to random chance and the success of your expeditions depends on how well prepared you are and how you use your items. 

[h1]Recruiting Wall[/h1]
The Recruiting Wall now features new signs that indicate the sellsword stats. 

[h1]Tutorial Update[/h1]
The Tutorial has been updated with information about Shelters.

[h1]Chapter 5 Patch[/h1]
We’ve rebalanced the dynamics of Chapter 5. Some players reported that, after dying and losing all their comrades, they were unable to progress in this chapter. [spoiler]A merchant was added next to Isabel[/spoiler] and new item drops. You’ll be able to fight through here with a great challenge, even if you fail on the first attempt.

[h1]Text[/h1]
All languages have had some adjustments.

[h1]Quest Fix[/h1]
[spoiler]You can now save Helga & Mahoram in the Main Quest line.[/spoiler]

[h1]Cutscene[/h1]
[spoiler]A special cutscene in Chapter 7 with Volrung in the end game has been fixed.[/spoiler]

[h1]Outro[/h1]
We will continue to monitor the community boards to discover bugs or mistakes that evaded us. Rest assured, those will be dealt with. As always, the community’s input and feedback is much appreciated. You guys are the best!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/7445232498eeed94bc6d9bdf478833986ddb5f82.png[/img]

We will continue diligently fighting bugs by moonlight, and improving the game by daylight!

-Team Devespresso Out!

We’re on a roll with updates and we have this amazing community to thank for it. Due to your constructive feedback, we’ve been able to implement some real improvements and there’s A LOT more in the pipeline. Here’s a summary for what’s coming in Patch 1.04:

[h1]Journal Tutorial Patch
[/h1]The game is chock full of main/sub quests and it’s very difficult to remember all of these. We’ve heard feedback that gamers were unable to find the To-Do List. As such, we’ve added a tutorial which will reveal itself after Lanvil’s interrogation.

[h1]Combat Fast-Forward
[/h1]Perhaps the most exciting new feature! When you hold the Shift button during Combat, the pace of the encounter will speed up.

[h1]Recruiting Board
[/h1]New recruits will populate the board more quickly. You’ll never have to worry about a lack of recruits now.

[h1]Equipping Relics
[/h1]Relics can now be equipped and unequipped on the field. This is primarily to allow players to dismiss a companion in order to bring on a new field hire. 

[h1]Chapter 7 Patch
[/h1]Some players reportedly got frozen in place here after entering the 2nd floor. We’ve implemented a fix for that!

///

[h1]Upcoming[/h1]

Version 1.05 is already in the works and, as we’ve mentioned in the previous updates, we are going to be implementing new camp nodes between neighborhoods. We’re also updating the recruiting wall so you will be able to see comrade stats before you hire them! 

We’re paying particularly close attention to community strategy around party combinations and relics. This will help us gauge balance as we discuss new ideas to implement. Stay tuned and, as always, your feedback is very much appreciated!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/7445232498eeed94bc6d9bdf478833986ddb5f82.png[/img]

We will continue diligently fighting bugs by moonlight, and improving the game by daylight!

-Team Devespresso Out!

Release: Out now
On: Windows, Mac OS X, Linux
From: Steam, GOG, Humble
For: 18, $25, 25

I wince when people dismiss bad films as just a load of CGI-heavy garbage , because I know people who work in the visual effects industry. Thanks to their harrowing anecdotes, I know just how much talent and graft goes into making blockbusters look pretty, and so I always feel bad when their efforts get sidelined as a footnote to an utter roaster of a flick.

Given this, it s going to be particularly painful to write what I m about to write about Vambrace: Cold Soul, a JRPG-styled roguelite released this week by South Korean studio Devespresso Games. Because while the game itself is about as much fun as eating raw eggs out of a loaded gun with a toothpick, it s absolutely gorgeous.

To our amazing community,

First off, we’d like to thank everyone for the awesome show of support with the game’s launch. It has been an absolute joy to watch people immerse themselves in the world of Icenaire. The journey of bringing this project to life has been a long, challenging road for our small team of four, but was a total privilege! 

That said, we are taking the community’s feedback seriously. Rest assured, we're working around the clock to assess and implement the adjustments we believe will improve your experiences.

[h1]Here's a short overview of what's in our first update for Version 1.02:
[/h1]

-Game Tutorial: The Escape Menu will provide access to a Game Tutorial section
-Speed: Walking speed in the town and dungeons will be increased
-Terror: The rate at which the Ghost Fog/Terror rises on the field has been slowed, giving players more time to explore
-Combat Encounters: The number of combat encounters has been decreased in each Neighborhood

Sincerely,

Team Devespresso

notes.title: Sarge's Advice for Exploring the Frozen Wastes!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/c3faf3d65fce48347aec2a1538d22b3375bfcb51.jpg[/img]

Alright, grunts! Looks like we’ve made it this far. You feel that chill in the air? Yeah, that’s the feeling of death creepin’ ever so slowly toward us. Literally. We’ve got a long way to go before we reach our expedition’s objectives, so listen up because I have a few golden nuggets of wisdom to impart. Who knows, it might just save your hide!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/6d7c1397ef2a46abe7c797afb970fc628a95a514.jpg[/img]

So, the basics first. As you greenhorns remember, I visited the Recruiting Wall in the Hunters’ Camp to hire you. It’s always important to make sure you assemble a team that complements your objectives and play style. Second, you want to make sure you’re well supplied and equipped for the expedition ahead. If we intend to reach our destination, there’s no going back...that is, unless you’re okay with losing all your progress.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/5a20a03ee297479060307d89aaecb6496f051dd4.jpg[/img]

Now this part’s really important. You can toss in the towel and run back home to momma at any time of your campaign (so long as you’re not caught up in something). The good thing about this is that all your surviving allies will come back with you. You also get the keep the loot you gathered while exploring the wastes. The bad news is that you will lose any progress you made toward your end goal. Listen, there ain’t no shame in making a tactical retreat. If your party falls on the campaign, you lose everyone, everything you gathered, AND all your progress. Sometimes you just gotta know when to call a spade a spade.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/6df06118f2f226ec4d5ec7f6564e9e5d8d05fce0.jpg[/img]

As we move between neighborhoods, we’ll have to make decisions about which paths to take. This is going to affect the layouts of the maps ahead and the frequency of certain encounters. Some neighborhoods have more hostile actors mucking about. Others are full of loot. The benefit of where to go is simply something you’ll have to learn about each district during your visits.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/01eac363d78e3ab398437682c3c63be66f38a44a.jpg[/img]

Ah, look at that. A clean map and everyone’s fresh as a daisy. Once you’re in a particular neighborhood, your job will be to navigate your team to the exit path. Along the way, we’re going to be facing a variety of randomized encounters on each street. What? You didn’t expect the forces of darkness to just lie down for us, did ya?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/6703398539848c765c3139b516bcaa4ef14ae253.jpg[/img]

As you can see, traveling from street to street will reveal what’s lying in wait for us. It could be loot, hostile enemies, traps, strange encounters, mercenaries for hire, and more.

Now, this doesn’t mean we can just bandy about willy nilly. Exploring streets causes our Vigor to drop by one point. Do you also see that little green bar in the bottom left corner? That’s the Geistometer. It measures the Ghost Fog in the air. That is, it lets us know how close Mad Shades are to our location. When it crosses a certain threshold…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/82e765f5f1718c4d7f26d05bd3876bd7a25bb0b3.jpg[/img]

Every path becomes hostile with powerful enemies. Getting to the exit becomes a much more challenging affair. Do you see that indicator in the upper left corner? That shows how close you are to the Boss Dungeon. You get closer by reaching the exit paths. Ultimately, all roads lead there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/8a5895dc2604f2e744d5abf3d867c3e1ae5256a5.jpg[/img]

If we survive everything else in our way, we still have to contend with the local Shade. Victory, is how we make sure our little tale progresses. So, you ready to get your hands dirty? Yeah, that’s what I thought! Move out!

notes.title: Sarge's Guide to solve Conflicts: Combat!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/5d55af2d650ab1987f6971339a8c7d2188e6c2c3.jpg[/img]

Listen up, grunts! 
We’re about to make for the surface. It’s no secret that Icenaire is crawling with vengeful wraiths and mad survivors right now. We’ve all lost friends to the King of Shades’ minions, so I don’t need to remind you: We need to be extra careful. In any case, we have our mission objectives and you’re our best hope for getting through this thing alive. 

What’s that? You’ve never walked the city streets post-curse? How’d I get saddled with a greenhorn like you?! Nevermind that. I don’t want any of you knuckleheads getting killed up there. It reflects poorly on me, after all. So, follow these instructions, and maybe we’ll all make it back in one piece.

First, the basics. For the purpose of this demonstration, we’ll be taking a look at a few key stats.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/3c031611d4684990c2f43978e9f1e14663f9e592.jpg[/img]

Your Health is indicated by the heart icon. It denotes damage you take in combat. Your Vigor is indicated by the flame icon. It denotes your weariness from the expedition. Looks like you’re pretty well rested right now. Unfortunately, that won’t be the case once we’re in the middle of our trek. Take damage in combat and this number is gonna drop. Wanna guess what happens when either of these stats hits 0?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/4b6b352307ce4396ac0ce64d0a1543a56f8e8a87.jpg[/img]

Right! You buy the farm. So, try not to let that happen, okay?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/51638f67d05f0a2df5dde166dcfd45115409d452.jpg[/img]

Your Combat ability is indicated by the crossed swords icon. The higher it is, the more likely you are to hit your enemies and deal more damage. Hmm, a 4, eh? Not so shabby! I guess appearances can be deceiving. There may be some hope for you after all.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/cd18f5b4e22c1964daf5a4347f8bb53f26a7fb99.jpg[/img]

Your Awareness is indicated by the eye icon. The higher it is, the more likely you are to alert and help your party avoid hidden traps. This will also increase your initiative when we begin turn-based combat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/485517a3d93e1adba68a7e9bbe98d6396687862a.jpg[/img]

When combat begins, every character will have access to two skills; your [b]Standard[/b] skill and your [b]Flourish[/b]. You can use the Standard skill every turn, provided you have something to target.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/3f2f2fc96c7cb39abcfcf059db72bdd52ace04fc.jpg[/img]

Your Flourish is a more powerful or specialized skill. It can be used when you charge your [b]Flourish Meter[/b]. You can do that by successfully attacking your enemies or making decisions quickly.

Hold your horses there, greenhorn. What’s that? You’re already itchin’ for a fight? We’re just getting started! I need to walk you through the turn based combat system first. It’s do or die up there and if we lose anyone they’re not coming back.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/043bb566702adb1d2f83eab2335ef0b229ce42a5.jpg[/img]

When you enter combat, your team members will be indicated in the upper left corner. Your enemies will be displayed in the upper right corner.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/928dc18e9e8f11ff5a5a2f390f808b011b007486.jpg[/img]
 
Positioning is [b]EXTREMELY[/b] important in this game. From the center, each fighter’s position will indicated in ascending order from 1-4 (for their respective side). Yellow indicates the player’s team. Blue indicates the enemy team.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/d216f191e137c3a79f6673cc5b6d49cc4eebef67.jpg[/img]

At the bottom of the screen, you’ll see this arrow. Remember the Awareness stat I discussed earlier? Your characters’ initiatives are determined by it. A character is more likely to take action earlier with a higher Awareness.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/8c6f2fe342175478f36f5ffc30fdb4e208e0b2cc.jpg[/img]

When a character reaches the arrow head, it’s their turn to make a move. You can see the order that characters will be taking action. Make sure to plan accordingly. It helps to study your enemies’ patterns.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/3d6c8f148a641e0e558cdce9e79a18ab7a7a8130.jpg[/img]

There are three basic [b]Attack Ranges[/b] in this game. Short, Medium, and Long Range. Every recruit brings their own unique strengths to your team and they specialize in very specific weapons.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/30c42be80a1fd2580a7b5d038dbbf62d961d1e38.jpg[/img]

Short ranged attacks can only target enemies in the first or second positions. They must also be performed from either the first or second positions.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/d74f84d2f680b8c7317dea110ffe5cf08491f874.jpg[/img]

Mid-ranged attacks can only target enemies in the first or second positions. They can be performed from any position in the party.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/4b7ae10ea53446067780e28d38f7bb7091071976.jpg[/img]

Finally, long-ranged attacks can be performed from any position and target any enemy. That’s my personal favorite. Haha!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/42a5423e44a24bb53e9fc91aae5bc8f6a222634d.jpg[/img]

Since good positioning is key, you can always swap places with other characters - even in the middle of combat! This could be a good idea if somebody in the front has been taking heavy damage and you want to put them in a safer spot.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/83c7753cebf00d6fe9d1dc748c65672ec52c3464.jpg[/img]

You can defend yourself to avoid damage. However, this comes at the expense of [b]Vigor[/b]. Remember, if your Vigor drops to 0...well, we can put a fork in ya.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/fd4d5441d06af958c679af6f6f7e2de094a70d81.jpg[/img]

Targeted enemies are indicated by the red reticule. Try to strategically focus your attacks on enemies based on their turn order or abilities.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/282f2a32529e017e074f2a6655f812781add69b3.jpg[/img]

If you dispatch an enemy, your remaining foes will move up in positioning. This also means that they may be targeted if they were previously out of range.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/3a48a0ff4bf0eafe31d46dba48d1add8016a6415.jpg[/img]

Now, this part is super important, so don’t forget it. You can’t access your inventory and start using items in the middle of combat. Now that wouldn’t be very realistic, would it? So, remember, you can only heal your characters if you either have someone with a unique ability to do so or manage to find a safe camping spot to unpack.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/9ef299cc495a1813669d005bef03c3866b76ceff.jpg[/img]

As harsh as this sounds, we’ll probably lose some good people up there. It can’t really be helped. Luckily, we still have a lot of able-bodied men and women in Dalearch who are committed to the cause. Make sure you visit the [b]Recruiting Board[/b] from time to time to assemble your team. Pay special attention to how your unique members’ skills complement each other in combat and the expedition at large.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/2ac503837fb80b6be59e92962084b35df893cd74.jpg[/img]

One more thing, if a team member perishes on the battlefield, they’re gone for good. That means you’ll lose the item that was equipped on them. It will also decrease your party’s ability to pack loot. If the main character, Lyric, gets knocked unconscious, the expedition is over. So, as side characters, we gotta make sure she is well cared for.

Alright, that’s all I have to say on this subject. Now, let’s see what you’re made of, soldier. Move out!

notes.title: From Etheria to Icenaire: The World of Vambrace
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/9975749365fb2a5785d32e4111ca755c1efddec2.jpg[/img]

[b]Vambrace: Cold Soul[/b] is a gothic fantasy set in the world of Ethera. This world is divided into several realms: Edena, home to the cosmopolitan humans and famed for its large metropolitan cities; Sylvia, realm to the matriarchal Sylvani Elves and a region of dense forests; Zumurrud, a vast, arid desert land and home to the Naziri Drows; Asadal, an island country called home by the seafaring Foxier merchants; and Dokkheim, a land in the frigid north that is home to the Dwarves, the world’s unrivaled smiths and tinkers. 

Icenaire was popularly known as “the Jewel of Dokkheim.” It holds the distinction of being the first Dwarven city built above ground. While the city was once a prosperous trade hub, it has long since fallen to ruin under a mysterious curse. The city has been surrounded by the Frostfell, an impassable wall of ice, ever since this curse took hold. Those who died within the city walls returned as mad or sober wraiths. The city’s survivors retreated underground, where they now wage a desperate campaign against the one responsible for this spell, the King of Shades.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/42d3e37712eaa6b29e7a555a89bcccfbb898e37a.jpg[/img]
[i][b]A map of Icenaire[/b][/i]

Evelia Lyric’s vambrace, an ancient relic known as the Aetherbrace, gives her the unique ability to pass through the Frostfell. Her presence emboldens the resistance fighters since she can lead small strike teams to areas that were previously inaccessible to them. Icenaire is divided into four distinct quarters: the entertainment, residential, industrial, and temple districts. 

The Entertainment District is the located in the northern quadrant of Icenaire. Unlike most Dwarven cities, which are stiflingly rigid and homogenous, Icenaire prospered greatly from its laissez-faire policies and open nature. As the years passed, this burgeoning quarter served to satisfy all manner of vices for the city’s diverse populace. Although it is now in complete ruin, not all is lost; the Ghost Bazaar, a vibrant trading hub is open for business. The spooks there are even willing to deal with the living who bring hell money to the table.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/e445e8cecaad3db67414e71a8ebb89c8c87027e7.jpg[/img]

The Residential District is the located in the southern quadrant of Icenaire. The ward once boasted thriving estates and commercial services catering to the needs of its local residents. Slums developed in certain areas of this district as a result of an influx of economic migrants. Dwarves, many of whom were significantly more affluent than their migrant counterparts, tended to live in other quarters of the city. This area was the site of the bloodiest fighting during the Incident and its ruins are a haunting reminder of the carnage that took place.  

The Industrial District is located in the western quadrant of Icenaire. The city was once a technological marvel, far outclassing its contemporaries. The innovations and practical work needed to maintain such advancements took place here. Cutting-edge factories loom large and maintenance golems go about their daily routines unimpeded. Access to most of this area was off limits to average citizens to prevent accidents and safeguard sensitive information. The city's "heart", the great Nibelung Furnace, continues to pump steam throughout Icenaire.    

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/ae44f3d7d5415e8417555aa18d023f4760cbcabd.jpg[/img]
[i][b]A city close up[/b][/i]

The Temple District is the located in the eastern quadrant of Icenaire. It caters to the varying religious needs and traditional practices of the city's multi-cultural people. The Dwarves, despite their agnostic background, sought to accommodate the diversifying population's needs by sanctioning religious practice in the district. Their plan succeeded in both satisfying the locals and drawing travelers to their iconic temples. One can now find academic facilities and temples dedicated to all manner of religions.

As Evelia, you will be leading campaigns through all of these punishing locations and more - each with their own distinct aesthetic, sub-quests, expeditions, loot, and encounters. We hope you will enjoy exploring this frozen city as much as we did creating it!

notes.title: This is Devespresso Games!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/ce6e354eddfa30b79aea13a0bf4efbf7828b2e9d.jpg[/img]

Devespresso Games is a small independent development studio based in Seoul, South Korea. Founded in 2015, the team settled on the name due to the fact that they never had a central office location and often do their dev work remotely in various cafés around Seoul. This tradition still holds true today with the team usually assembling for in-person meetings when the occasion calls for it (but, usually when one member happens to be passing through another's hood). From the team's inception, their design priorities have always focused on three conceptual cornerstones: 1.) Hand-illustrated, 2D graphics, 2.) Immersive, narrative-driven gameplay, 3.) Fun.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/1aa17be4269fd6b7ac0e63c36f2eb8f430e2854a.png[/img]

The team gets a lot of inspiration from studios, like Vanillaware, that have intentionally chosen to pursue a creative direction based on 2D aesthetics. They believe that the qualities of this art style are timeless, regardless of generation or platform. They also relish in the huge visual impact the art delivers as the game's first impression. The art and animation of games such as The Coma: Cutting Class and Vambrace: Cold Soul were all done by Minho Kim. These assets range from cutscene graphics, in-game level assets, dialogue GUI illustrations, and much more. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/dc19c8105ba0a30b411d94d9fd0cbb3b56dbd25a.png[/img]

The members also grew up on a steady diet of retro Western and JRPG classics. The team believes it's important that every story provides an immersive experience with interesting characters, plots, and concepts that leave an indelible impression on the player. T.L. Riven, the lead narrative designer, moved to Korea in 2006, where he would later encounter Minho. They began working together in the games media industry, but discovered they shared a passion for creating new worlds and bringing them to life. His journey as a lifelong gamer and working in South Korea as an English instructor would inform the narrative experience of The Coma series and mesh well with the conceptual foundation Minho had created for worlds such as Vambrace.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/5418f4fcead781fd9361b4a054af8c86d9d0202c.png[/img]

Hyunho Kim, Minho's younger brother, is a musician with a knack for making electronic dance music. However, as can be imagined, working on the team's game projects often call for tracks outside his favorite genre. He's collaborated with musicians like Norihiko Hibino, of Metal Gear Solid and Bayonetta fame, and Emi Evans who lent her amazing voice to the Nier: Automata soundtrack. The soundtrack for Vambrace: Cold Soul will be the most epic yet, featuring sweeping orchestral compositions and deeply atmospheric music.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/1b96390f6561f2af468dbba19483e1aac82e64f3.png[/img]

Minchan Kim, the brothers' cousin, is a programmer with a natural talent for making games. Vambrace: Cold Soul is his very first title, and an amazing accomplishment considering it's his first outing. Minchan began working on the game, part-time, while still finishing up his college degree. He had never used the Unity engine before, but learned its ins and outs within record time (he had 1-2 months to prepare for development). He'd go on to create nearly every one of Vambrace's game modules from scratch. He's also working on the team's newest title, The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters, and focusing on a new, exciting killer AI.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/1a37b7a77bdde75ea41e3c12e2eb10fb088590f7.png[/img]

Vambrace: Cold Soul represents a big departure from the team's first title, The Coma: Cutting Class. This time around, the team is focused on creating an epic story, featuring 25-30+ hours of replayable dungeon crawling, 10 character classes, and multiple endings. According to T.L. Riven, "This really represents the culmination of everything we learned from working on The Coma: Recut. We took those lessons to heart and made everything more expansive, deeper, and content rich. This game is for people who enjoy deep, fantasy stories and lore, punishing roguelite gameplay, and beautiful art. It's a real love letter to the JRPGs we grew up with and newer indie titles like, FTL, that have heavily inspired Vambrace's mechanics."

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/d6b84e8a30b0cf160ec5e36041cf3e63245301d1.jpg[/img]

Vambrace: Cold Soul will be available on May 28th for Steam on PC, Mac, and Linux.

notes.title: The Creation History of Vambrace #1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/2b3c6dfcbc2cbd0ec44d1fb7ee02a54aefbae247.jpg[/img]

[b]Vambrace: Cold Soul[/b] has been a long time coming. That is, the original concept is nearly 19 years in the making. In his youth, Minho Kim, our lead artist and CEO of Devespresso Games, often worked on the conjured world of Icenaire as a form of escapism. He populated the realm with a variety of interesting characters and dramatic events.

Most elements were loosely connected, while others found more solid form through discussions in Korean online forums. In there, he shared his art with other high-fantasy enthusiasts. They eagerly contributed to this ever evolving patchwork world. He even illustrated avatars for the most dedicated participants. Through the years, he honed his skill with pen and pencil. And though he would work on many new projects, Icenaire would remain a fond one. He eventually moved into the esoteric realm of game development.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/0ebdfa07a11df87cff8c61d11f3813b09f5d07fd.jpg[/img]



Tristan Lee Riven our game designer and COO at Devespresso Games recounts the dramatic shift. "I somehow managed to convince Minho to join me in this harebrained attempt to make our own game. That's despite the fact we had no experience or knowledge of how to do so under our belts." 

The two had met in Seoul, South Korea, when Tristan happened to walk by and see Minho working on some drawings. "I invited him for a coffee and we had a discussion about his art and some of my own ideas. Everything clicked right away. We both just enjoyed the creative process of making new worlds together," Tristan recalled. The team eventually managed to figure out the complex logistics of shipping an actual game. After completing their first title, The Coma: Cutting Class, Minho's new priority was returning to the land of Icenaire he had been working on for so long.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/16683df17c4cd72a283828de7a815308228d7804.jpg[/img]
